title: ENZ Launcher
summary: Windows launcher for the ARK dedicated server: pick a map, start, stop and watch the server from one window. Tauri 2, Rust, React and TypeScript.
features: Map picker and server start and stop
Dashboard with state, uptime, CPU, memory, players and a live log
Save the world and respawn wild creatures through RCON
Admin password kept in the Windows Credential Manager
Windows installer published in the GitHub releases
